build_net_message_passing_network: build a Net module to encode and decode messages using graph neural network message passing with configurable LSTM and dropout
build_netchunked_chunked_data_processor: build a NetChunked module to process time-chunked data with persistent message-passing state across chunks
run_net_forward_pass: run the Net forward pass on a batch of features to get output and hint predictions via message passing steps
run_netchunked_chunked_inference: run the NetChunked forward pass on chunked features with message-passing state to get predictions for streaming data
review_net_construct_encoders_decoders: review the Net _construct_encoders_decoders method to understand how per-algorithm encoders and decoders are built from specs
